description: Request a meeting with this company. First call with the user's details: you get a summary and a privacy notice to show them. Only after they confirm, call again with confirm_token to send it.

confirm_token.description: Only on the second call, after the user confirmed the summary.

message.description: What the user wants, in their words.

name.description: Full name of the user. Required.

offer_id.description: Optional. Id of the catalogue item the request is about (a flat to visit, a car to test drive, a product), as returned by search_offers. Omit for general requests.

phone.description: Phone number, with country code if possible.

preferred_time.description: When the user would like the meeting, in their words.

name: book_meeting
title: Book Meeting Tool
